item.title: Charli XCX Charges to No. 1 on ARIA Chart With ‘Music, Fashion, Film’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our music update! We've got the latest from the ARIA Charts. Let's dive in!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Charli XCX is off to a flying start, debuting at number one on the ARIA Albums Chart with 'Music, Fashion, Film'. This is her fourth top 10 appearance, and her second number one album after 'Crash' in 2022. She's knocking Amy Shark off the top spot, who was gunning for her fourth consecutive number one with 'soft pop'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Olivia Rodrigo is holding strong at number three with 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love'. And, Icelandic singer Laufey is making waves, jumping from 39 to 6 with 'A Matter Of Time: The Final Hour' as she kicks off her Australian tour."
[Short music transition]
Host: "We've also got some new entries on the chart. The Strokes are in at number 10 with 'Reality Awaits', and Australian singer Budjerah is debuting at 14 with his album 'Gentleman'. Shania Twain is back in the top 40 with 'Little Miss Twain', and Body Type is cracking the top 50 with their album 'Tally'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Over on the Singles Chart, Ella Langley is holding steady at number one with 'Choosin' Texas'. And, international girl group Katseye is making a splash with their new single 'Animal', co-written with Ed Sheeran, debuting at number 8."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in to our music update. We'll catch you in the next one!"
